name: East Haddonfield
imageAlt: Phelps Garage at night in East Haddonfield, an official Halloween: The Game screenshot
summary: Halloween: The Game map featuring the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage, with randomized objectives and escape opportunities each match.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: The official September 1 map announcement places the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage in East Haddonfield.

sections.title: Gameplay Notes
sections.body: Use the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage as orientation landmarks. Objectives, required items, and available escapes can vary between matches, so this page does not present one fixed route as universal.
